title: Reliable Capture & Extract · v0.9.8
changes: Remove all live-camera preview surfaces from immersive XR; the Quest passthrough already shows the room.
On capture save failure, clear temporary SAVING state and report the actual backend error; successful saves activate both Extract controls.
Keep Extract directly on the source image and in the right-side roundel; no additional menu required.
Remove default daily-request, per-profile, cooldown, duplicate-image, and 50-capture restrictions from the application. Limits are opt-in by server setting.
Preserve all saved captures, profiles, API credentials and other XR experiments.
